Error type: Intrinsic confusion (wrong even on clean audio)
Likely cause: acoustically similar classes / few (40) examples per class

Error type: Noise masking (correct clean → wrong at −5 dB)
Likely cause: low-energy or transient events buried below the noise floor

Error type: Broadband attractor (−5 dB error predicted as a noise-like class)
Likely cause: white noise resembles wind/rain/engine textures, so the model labels the noise, not the event

Error type: Unseen noise colour (correct at white 0 dB → wrong at pink 0 dB)
Likely cause: pink noise concentrates energy at low frequencies, masking bands not covered by training noise
overlapping spectral envelope once fine structure is masked
